name: agent-egress-audit
description: Audit agent packages for outbound clients, tracking indicators, sensitive input access, and execution hooks before installation.

name: dependency-provenance-audit
description: Review local manifests, lockfiles, lifecycle hooks, and dependency provenance without installing packages.

name: mcp-authority-review
description: Review MCP configuration for remote routing, shell launch authority, credentials, and tool restrictions.

name: security-exposure-review
description: Find local application security review leads and map them to reachable trust boundaries.

name: authorized-appsec-validation
description: Validate an explicit authorization and budget document before bounded application security testing.

name: agent-package-change-sentinel
description: Compare local package snapshots for content changes and newly observed capabilities before upgrades.

name: prompt-injection-boundary-lab
description: Generate offline synthetic prompt-injection cases and grade supplied structured agent response records.

name: secret-route-mapper
description: Interpret synthetic canary route records without reading or transmitting real credentials.

name: safe-install-sandbox
description: Produce a restricted Docker execution plan for inspecting untrusted installers in a disposable environment.

name: security-evidence-pack
description: Pack and verify reproducible local security reports with hashes, limited export fields, and explicit provenance limits.

name: instruction-boundary-audit
description: Review agent instruction files for priority overrides, approval bypasses, concealed transfers, and invisible characters before trusting them.

name: ci-workflow-security-audit
description: Review GitHub Actions workflows for mutable action references, privileged triggers, inherited secrets, broad permissions, and untrusted expressions.

name: container-boundary-audit
description: Review Dockerfiles and YAML deployment files for explicit root users, privileged containers, host namespaces, daemon sockets, and remote ADD sources.

name: infrastructure-exposure-audit
description: Review Terraform HCL source for world address ranges, wildcard policy scope, public storage settings, disabled encryption, and validation bypasses.

name: llm-data-boundary-audit
description: Review local LLM settings and source for explicit content capture, disabled scrubbing, remote code trust, provider endpoints, and TLS verification bypasses.
